name: The Ethical Compass: CSR, Profit and Doing the Right Thing
description: Advanced A-Level simulation of business ethics and corporate social responsibility at Horizon Apparel, a UK mid-market clothing brand. Players face five moral dilemmas covering supply-chain ethics, environmental CSR, tax strategy, whistleblowing and CSR reporting. Teaches the Friedman vs Carroll debate, greenwashing risk, legal vs ethical gaps, and the long-run economics of authentic CSR.
